label: Define the complete actual nonwoven-filament manufacture, monitoring and maintenance contract
definition: Confirm every full current personally assigned source duty, identify all operation/monitoring/maintenance methods and actual required results, record qualified versus learner acts and retain missing readiness/method/authority as unfinished. Separate knowledge, inert practice, operator demonstration and genuine learner manufacturing. Paper webs, hand crafts, supplier reports and simulated controller screens cannot replace actual nonwoven filament products.
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Defines full actual filament operation/monitoring/maintenance and efficiency scope
Identifies exact current product/machine/material methods and capable roles
Separates early starts, models and actual permitted manufacturing work

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: A qualified actual nonwoven manufacturer supplies a genuine suitable supported filament-production interval, exact machine/line/material/product specification, complete current manufacturer/site operating and maintenance methods, all competent actors and independent full result criteria. Current requirements include operation, monitoring, maintenance, accepted filament-product output and qualified high efficiency/productivity meanings. Hot polymer, pressure, moving/rotating/cutting equipment and substance controls are established through full actual task-specific competent arrangements. Documented early starts do not grant site access or machine authority; no live action is performed by authoring.
output_specification: Defines full actual filament operation/monitoring/maintenance and efficiency scope; Identifies exact current product/machine/material methods and capable roles; Separates early starts, models and actual permitted manufacturing work

focus.goal: Filament-product manufacture requires personally performed permitted operation, monitoring and maintenance with complete actual product and efficiency results.
new_concepts: Filament-product manufacture requires personally performed permitted operation, monitoring and maintenance with complete actual product and efficiency results.

alternatives: Provide accessible objects, diagrams, labels or an agreed partner description.
